title: The Undead Patron
contents: subtitle | Undead Warlock Patron
text | You've made a pact with a deathless being, one who defies the cycle of life and death in pursuit of eternal ambition.
text | These entities dwell in shadowy realms or rule from crypts and spectral thrones, offering power over undeath and secrets lost to time.
text | Such patrons promise strength drawn from fear, necrosis, and undeath, molding your presence into something otherworldly.
section | Beings include
text | <table class="spell-table"><tbody>
text | AcererakKas the Bloody-Handed
text | VlaakithDragotha
text | AnkhtepotAzalin Rex
text |

title: Form of Dread
contents: subtitle | Undead Feature
text | As a bonus action, you transform for 1 minute, gaining temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + your Warlock level.
text | Once per turn on hit, you can force a creature to make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of your next turn.
text | You are immune to the frightened condition.
text | You can transform a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
text | Your transformed appearance reflects your patron's nature.
footer | Warlock | Undead Patron | 3th Level Feature

title: Grave Touched
contents: text | You no longer need to eat, drink, or breathe, as your connection to undeath sustains you beyond mortal needs.
text | Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can replace the damage type with necrotic as it rots flesh and spirit alike.
text | While you are in your Form of Dread, you empower your necrotic strikes — when you deal necrotic damage, you may roll one additional damage die to increase its potency.
footer | Warlock | Undead Patron | 6th Level Feature

title: Necrotic Husk
contents: text | You gain resistance to necrotic damage. While using Form of Dread, you instead become immune.
text | When reduced to 0 HP, use your reaction to drop to 1 HP and deal 2d10 + Warlock level necrotic damage to any creatures of your choice within 30 ft. Gain 1 level of exhaustion.
text | This reaction recharges after 1d4 long rests.
footer | Warlock | Undead Patron | 10th Level Feature

title: Spirit Projection
contents: subtitle | 14th-level Undead Feature
text | As an action, project your spirit from your body, which becomes unconscious. Lasts up to 1 hour or until concentration ends.
text | Spirit and body gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing. Can cast necromancy/conjuration spells without components.
text | Gain flying speed equal to walk speed and can hover; move through objects as difficult terrain (1d10 force damage if ending turn inside one).
text | While using Form of Dread, regain HP equal to half necrotic damage dealt once per turn.
text | Once per long rest.
footer | Warlock | Undead Patron | 14th Level Feature
